"My True Story" is a 1961 single recorded by The Jive Five and co-written by the group's lead singer Eugene Pitt, along with Oscar Waltzer and Joe Rene.

sections.heading: Chart performance
sections.wikitext: The single was the biggest hit for the group on both the R&B and pop charts. "My True Story" made it to number three on the [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]] and was number one on the R&B Sides chart for three weeks.<ref>{{cite book |title= Top R&B/Hip-Hop Singles: 1942-2004|last=Whitburn |first=Joel |author-link=Joel Whitburn |year=2004 |publisher=Record Research |page=299}}</ref>
